panels.title: Integridad del Sensor Acelerométrico y Reloj

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_sensor" and r.station_id == "${station}" and r._field == "az")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_sensor" and r.station_id == "${station}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ax" or r._field == "ay" or r._field == "az")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "ax", "ay", "az", "clock_source", "status", "reason"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
